🎬 Bend It Like Beckham
2002 ‧ Comedy/Drama/Sport ‧ 1h 52m

📜 Storyline.
Jess, a football-obsessed British-Indian teen, dreams of playing professionally—but her traditional family has other plans. When she secretly joins a women’s team, she must balance culture, friendship, and ambition while chasing her goal on the pitch.

ℹ️ Title Info.
Director: Gurinder Chadha
Starring: Parminder Nagra, Keira Knightley

📺 Where to Watch.
Available on major rental/streaming platforms (region-dependent).

✨ Why Watch?
An inspiring underdog story about passion, identity, and breaking stereotypes.
